title: stipa oligotricha subsp. kiemii
intro: Stipa oligotricha subsp. kiemii, commonly known as Kiem's needle grass, is a type of plant species belonging to the family Poaceae. Kiem's needle grass is known for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, aiding in reducing inflammation and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Kiem's needle grass include its ability to exhibit antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-diabetic properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Kiem's needle grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a subject of interest in traditional medicine and modern pharmacology research.
